spec_match.rationale: Drives the complete grammar from the propdef (auto | content-width | content-height | content-block-size | content-inline-size; initial auto), the spec's statement that logical keywords resolve against the embedding element's writing mode, and the intrinsic-size-feeds-normal-replaced-sizing model (max-width/max-height/aspect-ratio clamping) against a child with a known 480×360 natural size.

interactive.rationale: Radio group for all five keywords, constraint checkboxes, writing-mode select, a reload-child control (intrinsic snapshot is per-load), a live readout of computed frame-sizing + measured box with interpretation, and a sequenced keyword-matrix runner that fills a results table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises all five keywords, constraint interaction and vertical writing-mode against one child; the page provides exactly those controls.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the empty-computed-value unsupported case (labelled 'property not parsed'), constraint clamping expectations stated with exact reference numbers, logical-vs-physical mapping under vertical-rl measured rather than asserted, and the per-load snapshot caveat; the matrix distinguishes honest-default behaviour from unexpected sizes even when unsupported.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5108373464547328 and the propdef-frame-sizing spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts each keyword's parse individually (per-valdef spec anchors), the keyword-only grammar negative, and the computed-value round-trip this page's readout mirrors.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CLI + CDP: autorun matrix completed all five keywords, each honestly measuring 304×154 (default + borders) with 'stayed at default — honest unsupported behaviour' readings and computed value reported empty/unsupported; zero console errors; fonts failures environmental. Keyword mappings, clamping, and vertical-rl behaviour on an implementing 153 build were NOT observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: responsive-iframe-sizing-matrix asserts the full five-keyword mapping on the supported path; responsive-iframe-sizing-matrix-unsupported-fallback separately asserts that an unsupported browser stayed at defaults.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; native fieldset/legend groups; select and buttons styled with paired colours; focus-visible outlines; the growable iframe sits in an overflow-x:auto stage so a 484px-wide box cannot overflow the page on mobile.

accessibility.rationale: Native radio group with role=radiogroup label, labelled checkboxes and select, aria-live polite readout, matrix table with caption + scoped headers, titled iframe; 44px minimum interactive heights.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated: zero horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 (the wide-box case is contained by the scrollable stage); controls wrap; mobile and desktop screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Measure the logical-keyword mapping and constraint interactions on an implementing build
openQuestions.detail: On a ResponsiveIframes-enabled 153 build: run the matrix and confirm content-width→484×154, content-height→304×364, and the logical keywords' horizontal-tb equivalence; then set writing-mode: vertical-rl and record which physical dimension content-inline-size/content-block-size actually take (the spec says logical directions resolve per the element's writing mode — the page measures rather than assumes); finally verify max-height: 220px clamps an intrinsic 360px height (scrollbar returns) and characterize aspect-ratio: 2/1 combined with a single intrinsic dimension. Update the reference-points note if any measured mapping differs.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel side by side comparison no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Intrinsic sizing and aspect-ratio are the sanctioned tools; wide content must scroll inside its own overflow container instead of widening the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the target iframe (up to 484px wide under content-width) is wrapped in .stage-scroll { overflow-x: auto }, and the demo itself teaches aspect-ratio/max-* interaction; CDP confirmed zero page overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form control groups radios checkboxes labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related controls with fieldset/legend, label every control, use native inputs with visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: frame-sizing radios and constraint toggles live in fieldset/legend groups, every input/select is label-wrapped, and focus-visible outlines are explicit.

summary: The reference page for the property's actual sizing model: full keyword grammar, logical-direction resolution on the embedding element, and the fact that the child-derived intrinsic size feeds ordinary replaced-element sizing where max-* and aspect-ratio still win. All readings derive from measured geometry with an honest empty-computed-value unsupported label. Verified on Chromium 141's fallback branch (matrix all-defaults); the implementing-build measurements are the open item.
